note: WP-VW-W4 (visit report v2): the doctor profile / potential sets (W4-BE-c). The ten report sets (W4-BE-a) follow the five profile sets. Tenant-scoped; display_name = English, label_* = the other six languages. Labels belong to the data owner and are corrected from the Reference Data screen, never patched by a script.

sets.description: A doctor's adoption stage of one of our products (WP-VW-W4, K-W4). The same list as the content journey stages: the visit report records it per product and the next visit's content follows it. Tenant-scoped.

values.description: Has not heard of the product.
Weighs the product for their patients.
Tries the product on some patients.

sets.description: How much of a doctor's patients in the product's indications get our product (WP-VW-W4, K-W4): a choice, never a percentage. The opportunity matrix reads it with the potential class. Tenant-scoped.
A doctor's adoption typology (WP-VW-W4, K-W5): kept on the doctor profile, suggested by the rep in the visit report, history kept. Tenant-scoped.
A doctor's communication style (WP-VW-W4, K-W5): kept on the doctor profile, suggested by the rep in the visit report, history kept. Tenant-scoped.
A doctor's key opinion leader level (WP-VW-W4, K-W5): kept on the doctor profile, suggested by the rep in the visit report, history kept. Tenant-scoped.

values.description: An opinion leader in their institution or town.
An opinion leader in the region.
An opinion leader in the country.
An opinion leader beyond the country.

sets.description: Whether the visit's key message landed, per product (WP-VW-W4, K-W4; replaces the mockup's star rating). Tenant-scoped.
What the doctor committed to at the end of the product discussion (WP-VW-W4, K-W4); feeds the next-visit message suggestion. Tenant-scoped.

values.description: Will try the product on some patients.

sets.description: The doctor's interest in a product during the visit (WP-VW-W4); the same codes as the W3 presentation interest mark, so the report pre-fills from it. Tenant-scoped.
What the doctor / pharmacy asked for during the visit (WP-VW-W4). Tenant-scoped.

values.description: An invitation to a training or a meeting.
A meeting with a medical science liaison.

sets.description: An advantage or disadvantage of our product against a competitor, as the doctor sees it (WP-VW-W4, optional). Tenant-scoped.
Who the rep met at a pharmacy visit (WP-VW-W4). Tenant-scoped.
A product's stock level at a pharmacy (WP-VW-W4). Tenant-scoped.
Where our product stands on the pharmacy shelf (WP-VW-W4). Tenant-scoped.

sets.description: A product's sales trend at a pharmacy, as the pharmacist sees it (WP-VW-W4, S3: required; the boxes per month are optional). Tenant-scoped.
How strongly the pharmacy recommends our product (WP-VW-W4). Tenant-scoped.
